'''icebreath Fury''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 MKOS icebreath DS 2004 5857.txt|Download]] (omits Rodian (V) (Virtual Set 3), Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3), Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

My best all-out beatdown deck.

'Defensive Shields - 10', all named (the Reflections III shields; Death Star Sentry (V) from Virtual Set 2). Secret Plans and Oppressive Enforcement here are the shields.

== Notes ==

* The four decks are the author's farewell set and post many unique cards in multiples (here Rystall, Ak-rev, Lyn Me, Tech Mo'r, Nizuc Bek, Elis Helrot and Scum And Villainy); dested as posted.
* Original-era (V): Death Star Sentry (V) (VS2, shield); Rodian (V) (VS3); Greedo (V) (VS4); Jabba's Influence (V) and Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6).
* Posted 'Omni Box & It's Worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse.
* Original-era printing corrected: Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

Fourth of four.  My final contributions to SWCCG.
